interview.hardest_part: Precise timing of throttle, steering corrections, and handbrake inputs on tight turns and jumps to maintain momentum and trigger every checkpoint segment without off-track or reverse errors
interview.likely_failure: Slight misalignment or delayed input when crossing the finish gate plane after the last segment, causing the coverage.gate_accepted flag to not register
interview.helpful_mechanics: Top-down perspective gives full visibility of track geometry and car position for perfect line adherence; automatic transmission eliminates gear shifting; simple key combinations allow fast reaction without complex menus during driving
interview.harmful_mechanics: Exact forward passage detection via ordered route.covered segments is sensitive to input timing and may fail on physics edge cases; handbrake drifting requires sub-frame precision that real-time screenshot feedback may not capture flawlessly
